summary: Second run of 08-15: 26/26 attempted, 0 tier moves, no upstream re-cut. TRANSCRIPT API KEY problem: limit-exceeded. WCL rdps broken, 3 raw keys landed. YouTube RSS recovered.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 181-329 KB, parsed from <table class="tier-list"> (first <td> = tier, entry img alt = "Spec Class" matched WHOLE against the roster). RAID: 40/40 read, ZERO moves against the 05:34Z run. M+ STILL BLOCKED, seventh day: the live M+ pages publish S+ / B+ / TBD bands the 5-band `icyveins` scale does not carry, and their 40 letters are again byte-identical to the icyveins-ptr list (re-verified 27/7/6 row by row), i.e. Icy Veins is still serving its PTR list as its live M+ list; 34 of 40 stored M+ letters would move if a merge were allowed. scales.json is the gate contract, so this remains an OWNER ESCALATION and the stored M+ letters are untouched. Recorded because it is easy to misread as an opening: the live M+ TANK page alone carries no out-of-scale band tonight (S/A+/A/B, 6/6 in-scale) - it was still not merged, because its letters are the same PTR-list rebuild as the two blocked pages and landing one third of a bracket would publish a half-updated M+ cut. Era: all six pages read Season 2 in title or body (the raid-healer page again keeps a 12.0.7 title over a Season-2 body - body over title, per the blue-tracker precedent), so seasonVerified stays s2 on all six and the source keeps feeding the consensus through the frozen lane. published re-read per page, never carried forward: raid DPS/Tank 2026-08-08, raid healer 2026-08-13, M+ x3 2026-08-08 - unchanged and agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence. Snapshots already stood at 2026-08-15 from the 05:34Z run of this same UTC day, so there was no date to advance; partial because only the raid half of the source can land.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 188-324 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as this source requires: every title reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)". 40/40 specs read (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank), ZERO tier moves - no rebuild since 2026-08-09, consistent with the Sunday 14:00 CEST cadence. Subtlety Rogue is still the literal upstream TBD and stays an explicit null, never omitted and never guessed (39 rated rows, floor 24). published RE-READ from each page rather than carried forward: JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-09 on all three, agreeing 3/3 with published-evidence. This is the SECOND run of 2026-08-15, so the snapshot was already at today's date and could not advance; the claim rests on the live re-read reproducing all 40 letters, not on a date bump.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 152-155 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched (the rejected alts are the 8 Season-2 dungeon names and the site logos), ZERO tier moves. Self-dates unchanged: raid "Last Updated 10th August 2026", M+ "Last Updated 13th August 2026"; the raid body names The Venomous Abyss three times and neither page mentions Season 1 at all. seasonVerified stays s2, so Method remains season-AHEAD: out of the live consensus in its own right and into the next-patch forecast, with its final s1 letters already in data/season-final.json keeping the consensus composition at 4. Snapshot already 2026-08-15 from the earlier run of this UTC day.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the full browser header set, HTTP 200 (a UA-only fetch is Cloudflare-403 on /guide/*; r.jina.ai is dead on this path and was not tried). Tiers parsed from the embedded [tier-list=rows] BBCode, whose closing tags are escaped as [\/...] inside a JS string. 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves - the six raid-DPS moves the 05:34Z run recorded have settled and nothing moved again. JSON-LD dateModified per page: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid tank 2026-08-14, raid healer 2026-08-08, M+ DPS 2026-08-13, M+ healer 2026-08-09, M+ tank 2026-08-11 - all unchanged and agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence. All six titles read "Midnight Season 2", so seasonVerified stays s2 (season-AHEAD: consensus via the frozen lane, letters into the next-patch forecast).

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag (specTierListSection.tierLists[], metric "throughput" for raid and "score" for M+, never the default popularity grouping; spec read from each entry's name and matched case/space-insensitively, since Archon writes "BeastMastery Hunter" / "Havoc DemonHunter"). 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. This is the same CUT, not merely the same letters: lastUpdated is 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z on all six AND every parse count is identical to the 05:34Z run - raid 3992 DPS / 1041 healer / 560 tank, M+ 1957260 / 661033 / 662388 - so Archon genuinely has not re-aggregated between the two runs. Note the contrast with last night, when the label held still while every raid parse count moved: the parse-count column, not lastUpdated, is the re-cut detector, and tonight it agrees with the label. The Season-1 raid pool remains collapsed (3992 against 219704 on 08-12), so a future single-night raid move here stays weak evidence. Era: the pages still describe Season 1 (the nine S1 bosses in encounterOptions, the eight S1 dungeons, zone label "VS / DR / MQD"), so seasonVerified stays s1 - Archon is the ONLY source still feeding the live consensus in its own right.

Full re-fetch of 9 Season-1 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, 51/51 HTTP 200, 0 unmatched. ZERO per-encounter tier changes in either bracket - every one of the 677 stored rows reproduces from tonight's parse. The same S1 sample collapse still leaves six role cuts publishing an EMPTY tier list upstream - Crown (all three roles; 142/38/20 parses), Chimaerus (healer 42, tank 39) and Vanguard (tank 44) - and per the standing "empty = nothing to ingest" rule those stored rows were LEFT UNTOUCHED rather than erased. File still holds 677 tier rows (floor 440), asOf still Archon's own cut date 2026-08-14, never the run date.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages (metric "survivability" specifically): 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched. ZERO tiers moved, for the second run running, and the underlying cut is unchanged at 2026-08-14 so nothing was merged. Same caveat as the throughput list: the raid sample behind these tiers is only 3992/1041/560 parses, so quiet is not the same as settled.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList, which carries letters only) on the raid DPS + raid tank pages = 33 rows, each with n = that spec's parse count. Every value AND every parse count is byte-identical to stored, and Archon's own cut label is still 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z, so there is no new cut to ingest: nothing was merged and the family's coverage date stays 2026-08-14 (1 day). PARTIAL rather than success because the stored date did not advance - re-stamping today would be exactly the re-stamp the bloodmallet/wowmeta asOf rule forbids. The raid healer page also exposes a dps column (healer DPS); it is excluded here exactly as the stored 33-row shape has always excluded it.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses. All seven values and all seven parse counts reproduce stored exactly against the unchanged 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z cut, so nothing was merged and the stored date is unchanged - partial for the same reason as archon-metrics. Emitted as its own row rather than folded into archon-metrics so a failure of one series can never be hidden by the other.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column: 40/40 specs parsed cleanly, and all 40 scores AND all 40 parse counts are byte-identical to stored for the sixth consecutive run - the M+ cut has not re-run since 2026-08-10 even though the page label reads 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z. Nothing was merged; the rows stay at 2026-08-10, which is now 5 days against maxAgeDays 5, so the heartbeat alarms from here. That red is the honest signal that Archon has not re-cut its M+ numbers, not a defect on our side.

80 rows parsed (40 raid + 40 M+) from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100, rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention. BOTH halves are byte-identical to stored this run - the raid half (merged yesterday at Archon's 2026-08-14 date) and the M+ half (last moved 2026-08-10) alike - so nothing was merged and nothing re-stamped. The family's coverage date is the older M+ half at 2026-08-10 (the probe takes the 60th-freshest of 80 rows), which is what previousAsOf/newAsOf report and why this is partial.

Fetched via the JSON API only, never the stale S3 HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, plain curl, HTTP 200. Selected categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField == lowerBound AND keyRange undefined - a WHITELIST, so the melee/ranged subsets cannot double-count the 27 DPS specs - giving exactly 27+7+6 = 40 rows with classSpec names byte-identical to the roster. UPSTREAM STILL HAS NOT RE-RUN: manifest.snapshotDate is 2026-08-11 for the fifth day (pipeline completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39.026Z, unchanged) and all 40 lowerBound values plus all 40 numberOfCharacters reproduce the stored rows exactly at 1 dp. asOf is the source's snapshotDate and never today, so nothing was merged; stored data stays at 2026-08-11 (4 days, maxAgeDays 8).

The rDPS-family series "Median rDPS (Mythic, all bosses[, tank])", "Median HPS (Mythic, all bosses)" and "Median DPS (Mythic, healer)" stay frozen at their stored 2026-08-10 values across all 47 rows (5 days, maxAgeDays 10).

Values did move against the 05:34Z run of this same UTC day - e.g. the 1T row on one spec 187408 -> 187782 as its ranked population shifted 39 -> 38 - so this is a genuinely new fetch even though the date label cannot advance twice in one day.

Also landed by the deterministic step: evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-raid-raw"] = 27 rows built and 27 applied, pooled over the six Venomous Abyss encounters that carry parses (Vashnik the Malignant 678 ranked players, Nek'zali the Soulcoiler 370, Entombed Sentinels 363, Sszorak 184, The Lost Explorers 150, The Twin Fangs 146; The Coiled Altar and Ula'tek both 0, an unopened testing window rather than an error). Stored as "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR M+ keys, pooled)", era ptr, at 2026-08-15.

All three meta pages (dps/healer/tank M+) re-fetched by plain GET, HTTP 200 - never r.jina.ai, which does not work on murlok. Parsed by splitting on <a> tags and testing for meta-item anywhere in the tag, because murlok's attribute order is not stable: a naive split on the literal class string silently dropped 4 of 40 rows on the first attempt tonight, and the tell that the corrected parse is clean is that the rank column is contiguous 1..27 / 1..7 / 1..6, which it is. 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, and every one of the 40 "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" values is again unchanged - the Season-1 M+ ladder is finished, so the top-50 ceilings are frozen in place until Season 2 opens on 08-18. Murlok publishes no self-date and no cut identity (the page states only "updated every 8 hours with live data"), so the fetch date IS the only honest observation date; the stored date was already 2026-08-15 from the earlier run of this UTC day and the live re-read confirms it.

BLOODMALLET HAS RETIRED THE MID1 CHARTS AND THE MID2 SET IS STILL INCOMPLETE - nothing could honestly be ingested, fourth consecutive night. All 27 DPS specs requested from talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 4 retries each: the SAME 14 returned charts and every one is simc_settings.tier == "MID2"; the SAME 13 (Havoc + Devourer DH, Balance + Feral Druid, Augmentation + Devastation Evoker, Windwalker Monk, Retribution Paladin, Assassination + Outlaw Rogue, Demonology Warlock, Arms + Fury Warrior) returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on all four tries. NEW TONIGHT: the 14 available charts were RE-SIMMED today - their own timestamps read 2026-08-15 07:35-07:37, up from 2026-08-12 - so upstream is actively working the MID2 set, but the roster is still 14 of 27. Merging 14 MID2 charts alongside 12 stored MID1 profiles would mix two sim tiers inside the within-role percentile labels the build derives from fightProfile, so the stored MID1 profiles are untouched at 2026-07-08 (38 days, maxAgeDays 5 - the heartbeat going red IS the honest signal). OWNER DECISION PENDING: adopt MID2 wholesale once bloodmallet has re-simmed the full DPS roster.

MID1_Raid.html re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 37.2 MB. Its own header still reads "Timestamp: 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000", SimulationCraft 1205-01 - the same completed report as the last eight runs, so there is no re-sim to ingest. Verified rather than assumed: all 26 stored "SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS" values reproduce EXACTLY out of today's copy, taking the best variant per spec from the FIRST chart data block (the later blocks are the burst/DTPS/priority charts and carry different quantities - matching on player name alone across all blocks silently reads the wrong chart and returns roughly 2.2x the right number). The same block also carries the six tank specs; they are not stored and were not added, matching the long-standing 26-row DPS-only shape. Stored rows stay at 2026-08-08 (7 days, maxAgeDays 10). Note the report is still simming 12.0.7, four days after 12.1 shipped.

Fetched DIRECTLY, HTTP 200, 185 KB (/period/latest 302s to /period/1075); r.jina.ai was not needed. Still period 1075, week 20 of MID1, top 2000 keys / 10000 characters (2863 unique), 22.6 average key level - no new weekly period, as expected with Season 1 finished and Season 2 opening 08-18. 34 spec bars parsed from the "Spec representation in top keys" figure by the img title attribute (the visible bar label carries only the number), and ALL 34 are byte-identical to stored. Unlike murlok, this source publishes a cut IDENTITY (the period id): an unchanged period plus unchanged values is the same cut, so nothing was merged and nothing was re-stamped - the rows stay at 2026-08-14 (1 day). Six specs remain absent from the figure upstream (Vengeance DH, Restoration Druid, Devastation Evoker, Protection Paladin, Holy Priest, Protection Warrior) and keep their older dates.

All three channels checked; NOTHING NEW - the feed stays at 16 entries, newest 2026-08-15, and no writeup or tierSet changed. (1) Official dev-notes thread 2317811.json: posts_count 17, highest_post_number still 19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31T23:42Z) - closed for this cycle. (2) Wowhead news RSS: 40 items spanning 2026-08-11..2026-08-15T01:05Z, parsed per <item> block; the newest item is 10 hours old so the window is identical to the 05:34Z run's, and its "Season 2 Class Tuning Incoming with Weekly Reset - Blood DK Nerf" is the mirror of the Aug-18 post already logged as entry #16. (3) Standalone blue posts: the Wowhead blue-tracker index is Cloudflare-403 to this runner (919-byte challenge body), so discovery was done against the forum's own Discourse search instead (search.json?q=@<staff>+after:2026-08-12 for Linxy / Kaivax / Aerythlea) - newest Linxy post is still topic 2336820 "Class Tuning Incoming - August 18" (2026-08-15T00:11Z), already in the feed. TRANSPORT NOTE for the next run: the 403 is on wowhead.com/blue-tracker specifically, and search.json answered every query in one round with no auth - prefer it. CHECKED AND DELIBERATELY NOT LOGGED: the Aug-14 live hotfix round-up (topic 2336376), whose post 1 was EDITED at 2026-08-15T01:00:47Z and re-posted as post 18, which is why it can look new. Its Classes section is bug fixes only with no tuning numbers (Devastation's Shattering Star now correctly benefits from Mastery: Giantkiller; Arms/Fury Slayer's Executioner no longer double-dips; Warlock pets stop re-learning Soul Leech; a Demonology cooldown-manager display fix), and everything numeric in it is trinket/item tuning or reward plumbing - the same disposition the 05:34Z run gave the Aug-13/Aug-14 round-ups. Zone 54/52/56/57 are evidence-only for this agent and are reported under their own WCL keys. Writeup coverage recomputed rather than read: 39/40, Demonology Warlock's null deliberate (the source reported no changes, and "nothing changed" is not a verdict). KNOWN CONSEQUENCE STILL OPEN, LEFT FOR A LOCAL RUN: yesterday's eight tierSet edits still make check-refresh --age report gearing-tierset-sync; the fix is node gearing/src/sync-tracker-fields.mjs + npm run gearing:build under gearing/, which the nightly publish job does not stage, so running it here would orphan the edit. npm test and the publish gate are unaffected; only the heartbeat alarms.

TRANSCRIPT API KEY problem: limit-exceeded. transcript-fetch/summary.json (2026-08-15T10:57:18Z) reports verdict "limit-exceeded" on the single video it attempted (bqVHzvKJCuA), 1 requested / 0 fetched, "remaining queue untouched" - Supadata's free tier is 100 requests per MONTH and the budget is spent, third night running. No transcript was readable, so ZERO takes and ZERO metaNotes were added, changed or superseded, and this agent fetched no transcript from YouTube or any transcript API by any means. DISCOVERY RECOVERED: last night's RSS 404 wall (40 of 44 channels, four backoff rounds) did not recur - youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml answered 44/44 channels on the first attempt, 660 videos, 0 failures, so that was the documented transient burst after all and yt-dlp stays the fallback rather than the default. Seen-set rebuilt from the four structured lanes (seen 502 + skipped 295 + queued 43 + every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote = 1027). 14 unseen, ALL 14 at or after the 12.1 cycle's opening build (2026-06-18, the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, taken as a date and never as an index). 8 queued under the nightly keyword filter (queue 43 -> 51): Preheat's 12.1 Arcane Mage guide, Supatease "12.1 CLASS TESTING POWER", Bansherz Friday-tuning Hunter stream, MadSkillzzTV on the Resilient key system, a Shadarek Havoc-guide stream, Shindigg's 12.1 launch stream and two LBNinja7 Mistweaver streams. 6 were not queued and NONE was written to seen[] - deliberately: that lane is for date-bound or newest-first dismissals, whereas a KEYWORD dismissal is a nightly-only economy (Supadata's monthly quota), and burning it into seen[] would permanently retire the video from the unfiltered LOCAL sweep. Left unexamined for a local run: Kalamazi "Main/Alt Gearing and Prep" (a Warlock authority on S2 gearing - the best of the six), Tettles, Maximum's AWTF PvP test stream, NeekapHere on the Coiled Isle, a Megasett achievement short, and Dalaran Gaming's "Demon Hunters Are BACK With Vengeance In 12.1! (5v5 1v1 Duels)", which matches the keyword filter but is PvP duel content and so out of scope for this PvE tracker. No generalCreators upload was in scope, so no latest field moved and community.json is untouched. Coverage recomputed: every spec holds at least one live take; Brewmaster Monk is still the only spec with no RAID-scoped one, and nothing queued tonight is Brewmaster.
